configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server as shown in the Steam server browser

configurationFields.label: World Save Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the world save folder to load, or to create if it does not exist

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for players to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for players to become a whitelisted admin in-game. Default is no password (disabled). Recommended for console users, as manual admin whitelisting is only supported for Steam

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Crossplay Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to allow crossplay or to limit the server to a specific platform

configurationFields.label: Use CPU Performance Threads
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be forced to use performance threads on the CPU. Recommended

configurationFields.label: Use All Available Cores
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be forced to use all available cores. Disable Pause To Load Assets if you use this. Recommended on newer hardware

configurationFields.label: Pause To Load Assets
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be forced to pause to load new assets/level sectors instead of slowly loading them. Recommended on older hardware

configurationFields.label: LAN Only
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be run as LAN only, which allows the server to be found in-game using the server browser set to LAN Only. Port 14001 must be accessible for server discovery to work

configurationFields.label: Use Local IPs
configurationFields.description: If set, allows the server to bind to local IPs as well as the Application IP Binding, assuming the Application IP Binding does not otherwise do this. Use with care, as enabling this setting may cause port conflicts

configurationFields.label: Enable UE4SS UObject Listeners
configurationFields.description: If set, UObject listeners will be created in GUObjectArray to create a fast cache for use instead of iterating GUObjectArray. Recommended to keep disabled for UE4SS mods to avoid crashes

configurationFields.label: Additional Command Line Arguments
configurationFields.description: Specifies additional command line arguments (anything that begins with a - ) that are not otherwise set by GSCS. Use with care

configurationFields.label: Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: When creating a new world save, sets (for all players) how many enemies may be present in some areas, how aggressive they are, and how fast they react in combat. Overridden to Apocalyptic if Hardcore Mode is enabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Hardcore Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, characters only have one life and difficulty is forced to Apocalyptic

configurationFields.label: Enable Loot Respawn
configurationFields.description: If set, resources (other than furniture) will spontaneously respawn around the Facility. Good for public servers, but can cause objects to intersect or float, and will make some resource gathering very unbalanced

configurationFields.label: Shut Off Power Sockets At Night
configurationFields.description: If set, power in the Facility will be shut off at night, including power sockets. Disabling this setting will make the game easier as things like Batteries will not be required. Disabling may also be required if the Day-Night Cycle State is set to 'Always night'

configurationFields.label: Day-Night Cycle State
configurationFields.description: Sets whether to disable the day-night cycle. If 'Always day' or 'Always night', time will pass as normal, but there will be no day-night transition. Change from 'Normal' at your own risk, as that may affect things that can only happen during day or night

configurationFields.label: Day-Night Cycle Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the speed multiplier for the day-night cycle. Higher will make clock time pass faster. This will NOT affect the speed of other cooldowns, respawn times, and so on

configurationFields.label: Weather Frequency
configurationFields.description: Sets how often weather events are triggered. Even frequent weather still requires the correct progression to trigger, however

configurationFields.label: Sink Refill Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets how quickly sinks will passively refill over time. Higher will mean sinks refill more quickly, and a lower value will make them refill more slowly. 0 = disable sink refill, making the game much more challenging

configurationFields.label: Food Spoil Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets how fast food spoils. By default, most food will eventually decay and turn into rotten food. Higher will mean faster decay, lower means slower. 0 = decay disabled

configurationFields.label: Refrigeration Effectiveness Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets how effective it is to refrigerate items. Also affects how effective hot items maintain their heat if they prefer staying warm and are kept in a warm location

configurationFields.label: Enemy Spawn Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets how frequently enemies respawn. Lower will increase enemy respawn timers, higher will cause enemies to respawn more quickly than normal. Minimum 0.5

configurationFields.label: Enemy Health Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for enemy health. Lower will make enemies easier to kill, higher will mean enemies will take more damage to kill. Minimum 0.75

configurationFields.label: Enemy Player Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets how damaging enemies are, as a multiplier of their damage. Default value is tuned for a fair and balanced experience. Lower will make survivability easier, higher will make combat more challenging and enemies more lethal. Minimum 0.25

configurationFields.label: Enemy Deployable Damage Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets how much damage enemies do to deployables, as a multiplier of their damage. Lower will make bases more resistant to enemy attacks. Minimum 0.1

configurationFields.label: Damage To Allies Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets how much damage players do to other players, as a proportion of normal damage. To allow players to engage in PvP combat, set to 1.0 (100%) or higher

configurationFields.label: Hunger Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for how fast Hunger increases. Higher will mean players need to eat more often

configurationFields.label: Thirst Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for how fast Thirst increases. Higher will mean players need to drink more often

configurationFields.label: Fatigue Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for how fast Fatigue increases. Higher will mean players get sleepier more quickly

configurationFields.label: Continence Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for how fast Continence drains. Higher will mean players have to use the toilet more often

configurationFields.label: Detection Speed Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets how fast enemies detect players. Above 1 will mean enemies will detect players faster than normal. Minimum 0.1

configurationFields.label: Bonus Perk Points
configurationFields.description: Determines how many additional perk points are available on top of the points given by each selected job

configurationFields.label: Player XP Gain Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for how fast XP is gained by players. Above 1 will mean XP is gained at a higher rate, below 1 will mean XP is gained slower. 0 = disable ability to level up skills

configurationFields.label: Item Stack Size Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for how many times items can be stacked in an inventory slot. For example, 2 = double stack height. Non-stackable items are excluded

configurationFields.label: Item Weight Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier affecting how heavy items are in a player's inventory. For example, 2 = twice as heavy. For items to be lighter, set this value lower than 1

configurationFields.label: Item Durability Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets the multiplier for item durability. For example, 2 = double durability. To break items faster, set this value below 1

configurationFields.label: Durability Loss On Death Multiplier
configurationFields.description: Sets how much durability is lost on weapons and items in a player's inventory when respawning

configurationFields.label: Show Death Messages
configurationFields.description: If sets, players will be notified when someone is killed by something

configurationFields.label: Allow Recipe Sharing
configurationFields.description: If set, players will be able to share item recipes with other players

configurationFields.label: Allow Pagers
configurationFields.description: If set, Pagers will be usable in inventory and via the emote wheel. Disabling this setting will make it harder to find other players

configurationFields.label: Allow Transmog
configurationFields.description: If set, players can transmogrify their armour to look like other pieces of armour using a certain piece of base equipment

configurationFields.label: Disable Research Minigames
configurationFields.description: If set, the Research Minigames will be removed when unlocking new recipes and simply unlock the recipe right away

configurationFields.label: Death Penalties
configurationFields.description: Sets what penalties a player receives for respawning after death (or by using the Unstick option)

configurationFields.label: First Time Starting Weapon
configurationFields.description: Sets the weapon players receive when spawning for the first time, in addition to starting items from their selected Job

configurationFields.label: Allow Death Bag Inventory Access
configurationFields.description: If set, the host will be able to access the inventory items found in Death Bags, which are typically dropped by players on death

configurationFields.label: Restrict Containers
configurationFields.description: If set, containers will be restricted by item type

configurationFields.label: Structural Support Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the limit on how much furniture and other deployables can be stacked. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Allow Character Reset
configurationFields.description: If set, allows players to reset their jobs, skills, and traits later in the game. Disabling removes the ability for scientists to change their mind

configurationFields.label: Bridge Supports Level
configurationFields.description: Bridges require two supports by default. When lowered, bridges will work with less or 0 additional support (besides the initial location the bridge is placed)

configurationFields.label: Allow Home Worlds
configurationFields.description: If set, Home Worlds can be used in the world. If disabled, access (for all scientists) to Home World portal worlds will be restricted. This includes free or DLC Home Worlds, such as Torii

configurationFields.label: Enable Invisible Radiation
configurationFields.description: If set, radiation will not show any screen effect, requiring Geiger Counters to track radiation

configurationFields.label: Base Inventory Size
configurationFields.description: Sets the default inventory size when no backpack is equipped

configurationFields.label: Enable Tainted Sink Water
configurationFields.description: If set, sink (or similar) drinkable water sources will instead be tainted water

configurationFields.label: Radiation Deals Damage
configurationFields.description: If set, radiation will actively deal damage to health

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Furniture Destruction
configurationFields.description: If set, player-built furniture will be destroyed when it reaches zero durability

configurationFields.label: Allow Iron Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, enables Iron Mode (additional restrictions when Hardcore is enabled). Requires Hardcore Mode to be enabled to take effect

configurationFields.label: Enemy Accuracy Level
configurationFields.description: Determines how accurate enemies are, on average

configurationFields.label: Apocalyptic Abilities
configurationFields.description: If set, all enemies can use their apocalyptic abilities even if Apocalyptic difficulty is not enabled

configurationFields.label: Maximize Enemy Spawns
configurationFields.description: If set, all enemy spawn points will be enabled, regardless of the difficulty setting or how many players are in the world

configurationFields.label: Mod List
configurationFields.description: Sets the list of mods the server will run with, separated by semicolons (e.g. 6472275;6472552;6456360). Mod IDs can be found at [mod.io](https://mod.io/g/abiotic-factor). Unlisted dependencies of a mod are downloaded automatically only if a Modio Token is set. Otherwise, it is up to you to make sure your list of mods will work correctly

configurationFields.label: Modio Token
configurationFields.description: Sets the mod.io personal access token, created from your account [here](https://mod.io/me/access#tokens). Without a token, the server will re-download the mods every time it starts. WARNING: Do not share your mod.io token with anyone

configurationFields.label: Mod Install Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets how long to wait for mod downloads to finish before failing. Default is 900 seconds

configurationFields.label: Override Mod Warnings
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will bypass any modding warnings in the server log that would otherwise stop it from starting up and running. WARNING: Only use this if you know what you are doing

configurationFields.label: Allow Local Only Mods
configurationFields.description: If set, players can join with their own local-only cosmetic mods enabled

configurationFields.label: Mods Directory Override
configurationFields.description: Sets a specific folder for the mod download location. Requires a Modio Token to work. Default is AbioticFactor\Saved\mod.io

configurationFields.label: Sideload Mods
configurationFields.description: For advanced users only. If set, the server will skip downloading mods through mod.io and mount pre-downloaded mods from disk instead. Mod List is still required, but only to specify which mods there will be. NOTE: This feature was added for game server providers, so troubleshooting support for it will be limited

configurationFields.label: Sideload Mods Path
configurationFields.description: For advanced users only. Sets the mods folder used by Sideload Mods. Default is AbioticFactor\Mods. NOTE: This feature was added for game server providers, so troubleshooting support for it will be limited

configurationFields.label: Install UE Scripting System
configurationFields.description: Sets the action to take when the server is updated. If the installation option is selected, the latest build of the [igromanru experimental Unreal Engine 4/5 Scripting System](https://github.com/igromanru/AF-UE4SS) will be installed, allowing the server to be modded
